description: Rules for effective use of cryptography including key management are not defined and implemented. This signal indicates that cryptographic controls, encryption standards, key management procedures, or cryptographic protocols are not properly established, documented, or enforced across the organization.
applicability: Applicable to all systems using cryptography including data at rest encryption, data in transit encryption, key management systems, certificate authorities, encryption key storage, cryptographic protocols, digital signatures, and cryptographic libraries. Includes cloud encryption, database encryption, file system encryption, and application-level cryptography.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of cryptography policies, encryption configurations, key management procedures, certificate management systems, protocol configurations, cipher suite selections, and compliance with cryptographic standards. May also be identified through code review, configuration assessments, and cryptographic inventory.
